div.head: VIIa Atr 5
div.ab: ⁊ hiredmanna gehwilc sille pænig to ælmessan, oððe his hlaford sille for hine, buton he silf hæbbe; ⁊ heafodmen teoðian.
⁊ hiredmanna gehwilc sille pænig to ælmessan oððe his hlaford sille for hine, buton he silf hæbbe, ⁊ heafodmen teoðian.
And every member of a household shall give a penny as alms, or his lord shall give it for him, if he has nothing himself, and men of position shall pay tithes.
And each member of a household is to pay a penny as alms, or his lord is to pay it for him, if he has not got it himself; and men of rank shall pay a tithe.
Und von Haushaltsuntergebenen zahle jeder 1 Pfennig als Almosen, oder sein Herr zahle statt seiner, ausser wenn jener selbst [so viel] hat; und Adlige sollen zehnten.
And let every member of a household give a penny as alms, or his lord give it for him, unless he has [that much] himself; and let the chief men pay tithe.
div.note: heafodmen, men who maintain households; the Latin has omnis tainus
